issue_request: FHIR-8028 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Structured Documents change request for the Documents page. It reported that the Profile Tags link in Document Profiles went to the wrong page and asked why documents would not identify profile conformance using resource metadata rather than the old feed.category wording; the Jira resolution was to fix the page, with a Jira comment indicating the Bundle was probably the appropriate place for the assertion.

Quoted Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant discussion that changes the Jira/source/git conclusion.
